suppression: HHS suppresses source cells built from fewer than 12 claim lines: those combinations are ABSENT from the source file. Absence is missing data, NEVER zero.
outlierTreatment: Every monetary aggregate is published twice: all-cells and excl-outliers (excluding the 62 source cells with TOTAL_PAID > $1B). The naive all-cells sum must never be presented as program spending.
notes: patients_reported is a reported-patient volume, not a unique-beneficiary count.
